lead: B. S. Yediyurappa is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 27 February 1943 in Mandya district.
As of 2026, he is 83 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
This profile collects the B. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: B. S. Yediyurappa — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha, Chief Minister of Karnataka (2019–2021), Chief Minister of Karnataka (2018–2018) and Chief Minister of Karnataka (2007–2011). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2020.
